title: sverify command output
description: The JSON document every `sverify` command prints with --format json (#744, API review I5). Format 1. Within 1.x the format only gains optional keys, values from a fixed set may gain new values, and readers ignore keys they do not know (docs/stability.md). Each checked node carries its report as Report.to_json() writes it, in the format of report.schema.json.

sverify.description: The version of sverify that wrote the document.

exit.description: The exit code: 0 proved (a refresh committed every row), 1 not proved, 2 usage error, 3 unsupported or refused, 4 time or memory budget exceeded, 5 a refresh quarantined rows or held a node, 6 error.

status.description: The exit code in words. 1.x may add values.

target.description: The node or transform asked for (file.py:<target>); null for the whole file.

items.description: check (and a refresh that did not run): each application of a contracted transform, in the order the file made them.

findings.description: check: what the check found wrong, one per postcondition not proved, needed precondition, possible runtime error, broken link or unchecked transform: the view the text, github, sarif and junit outputs print.

unchecked.description: check: the contracted transforms the file defines but never applies.

error.description: What stopped the command; null if nothing did.

budget.description: check: the time budget and the time spent, in seconds.

fixes.description: check --fix and --diff: the preconditions each transform needs, per parameter, as code for requires=.

placed.description: Whether --fix could write them into the decorator.

reason.description: Why they were not placed; null if they were.

diff.description: check --fix and --diff: the change to the file, as a unified diff.

applied.description: check --fix: whether the file was written (and checked again; the rest of the document is that second check).

nodes.description: refresh: what each node's refresh did, upstream first.

summary.description: StageRefresh.summary(): one line, or the full entry where something is notable.

held.description: Why the node did not take the batch (on_violation="hold", or a stored node it reads with no state yet); null if it took it.

quarantined.description: How many rows of the node's sources were quarantined.

quarantine_table.description: The quarantine table the rows went to; null if none.

quarantine.description: Each quarantine write's record, in the format of quarantine.schema.json.

alert.description: refresh: Refresh.alert(), what needs attention when rows were quarantined or a node held; null otherwise.

code.description: explain: the code, in snake case.

text.description: explain: what the code means and how to fix it.

nodes.description: The file's variables that hold the node this application built.

status.description: proved; checked (every postcondition it does not prove is checked on the data at each refresh); not_proved; or unfinished (the time budget ran out first).

summary.description: The contract in plain words; null when unfinished.

checks.description: What each refresh checks on the data before it writes.

not_proved.description: What is not proved, and the runtime errors it may raise.

links.description: Preconditions on another transform's result that its guarantees do not imply, one message each.

report.description: Report.to_json(), in the format of report.schema.json; null when unfinished.

code.description: The code `sverify explain` takes, in snake case (the report's reason or issue kind, or needs, composition, unchecked, timeout, ...). 1.x may add values.

line.description: The line of the transform's decorator in the file.

condition.description: The postcondition or needed precondition, as its label.

table.description: The input table a needed precondition is on.

code.description: A code `sverify explain` takes: usage, unsupported, refused, not_proved, timeout, memory or error. 1.x may add values.
